name: fxr_intro_box
doc: Stands in for saves/intro_box.state (the owner's capture of Mom's first box in the opening): from the new game's overworld pan (ow_intro_pan) 1540 frames of nothing, A every 12 frames 46 times (the wake-up text, into loc 002), then nothing: Mom (obj8 at @058A) opens her box at the bottom ($0126 = 02) at f2160, types its first line and waits from f2209 ($0129 = 07, $0131 = 01) -- cut at f2215, storyline 00, as the capture.
